results.content: Amid President Donald Trump’s record-low approval ratings nationally, a new YouGov/Economist projection shows the president's net job approval is negative in all but three states. According to The Economist and YouGov, more people disapprove than approve of Trump’s job performance in 47 out of 50 states and in the District of Columbia. The three states where the majority of respondents still approve of the president are Wyoming (+14), Idaho (+9), and West Virginia (+6). The lowest net job approval rating for Trump was in D.C. results.content: ## The president is getting bad news from his base with less than 3 months to the midterms. Donald Trump is getting a major warning from his own party as a string of new polls show Republican support for the president slipping sharply ahead of the midterms. An Economist/YouGov poll released Tuesday put Trump’s approval among Republicans at 79 percent, down 12 points from January 2025. A Financial Times poll found Trump’s net approval among Republicans had fallen eight points in one month, while an ActiVote survey also found Republican approval at 79 percent, down from 86 percent in January 2025. results.content: One-third of Americans approve of President Trump’s job performance, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos survey. The president’s approval rating, as measured by Reuters and Ipsos, is down 2 percentage points from a survey the polling partners released Aug. 3. As his second term began, Trump was above water with approval rating, as 47 percent of respondents to a January 2025 Reuters/Ipsos survey approved of his performance and 41 percent disapproved. Days before Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu launched the war with Iran, the U.S. leader’s disapproval rating was 58 percent, according to a Reuters/Ipsos survey.
